cases.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], FILTER(ALL(Product[Category]), Product[Category] IN {"Bikes", "Accessories"}), "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity]), "sel", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLSELECTED(Product[Category])), "all", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALL(Product[Category])))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], Customer[Country], FILTER(ALL(Customer[Country]), Customer[Country] = "France"), "sel", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLSELECTED()))

EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], FILTER(ALL(Product[Category]), Product[Category] IN {"Bikes", "Accessories"}), "n", COUNTROWS(ALLSELECTED(Product)), "m", COUNTROWS(ALLSELECTED(Product[Category])))

EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], FILTER(ALL(Product[Category]), Product[Category] IN {"Bikes", "Accessories"}), "share", DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLSELECTED(Product[Category]))))

EVALUATE ROW("a", CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLCROSSFILTERED(Product)), Product[Color] = "Red"), "b", CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLCROSSFILTERED(Product)), Customer[Country] = "France"), "c", CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALL(Product)), Customer[Country] = "France"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", COUNTROWS(FILTERS(Product[Color])), "b", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FILTERS(Product[Color])), Product[Category] = "Bikes"), "c", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Product[Color])), Product[Category] = "Bikes"), "d", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FILTERS(Product[Color])), Product[Color] IN {"Red", "Blue"}))

EVALUATE ROW("a", COUNTROWS(GENERATESERIES(1, 5)), "b", SUMX(GENERATESERIES(1, 5), [Value]), "c", COUNTROWS(GENERATESERIES(1, 2, 0.5)), "d", SUMX(GENERATESERIES(1, 2, 0.5), [Value]), "e", COUNTROWS(GENERATESERIES(5, 1, -1)), "f", COUNTROWS(GENERATESERIES(5, 1)), "g", COUNTROWS(GENERATESERIES(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 5))), "h", MAXX(GENERATESERIES(DATE(2024, 1, 1), DATE(2024, 1, 5)), [Value]))

EVALUATE ROW("a", COUNTROWS(UNION({1, 2}, {2, 3})), "b", COUNTROWS(DISTINCT(UNION({1, 2}, {2, 3}))), "c", COUNTROWS(INTERSECT({1, 2, 2, 3}, {2, 3, 4})), "d", COUNTROWS(EXCEPT({1, 2, 2, 3}, {2})), "e", SUMX(EXCEPT({1, 2, 2, 3}, {2}), [Value]))
EVALUATE UNION(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Product, Product[Category] = "Bikes"), "a", Product[Product]), SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Product, Product[Category] = "Clothing"), "b", Product[Product]))
EVALUATE ROW("a", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), INTERSECT(VALUES(Product[Category]), FILTER(VALUES(Product[Category]), Product[Category] = "Bikes"))))

EVALUATE NATURALINNERJOIN(SELECTCOLUMNS(Product, "ProductKey", Product[ProductKey], "Color", Product[Color]), SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Product, Product[Category] = "Clothing"), "ProductKey", Product[ProductKey], "Cat", Product[Category]))

EVALUATE NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(SELECTCOLUMNS(Product, "ProductKey", Product[ProductKey]), SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Product, Product[Category] = "Clothing"), "ProductKey", Product[ProductKey], "X", Product[Product]))
EVALUATE NATURALINNERJOIN(SELECTCOLUMNS(Sales, "ProductKey", Sales[ProductKey], "Qty", Sales[Quantity]), SELECTCOLUMNS(Product, "ProductKey", Product[ProductKey], "Name", Product[Product]))
EVALUATE TOPN(2, Product, Product[Category], ASC, Product[ListPrice], DESC)
EVALUATE ROW("a", COUNTROWS(TOPN(0, Product, Product[ListPrice])), "b", COUNTROWS(TOPN(-1, Product, Product[ListPrice])), "c", COUNTROWS(TOPN(50, Product, Product[ListPrice])))
EVALUATE GROUPBY(Product, Product[Category], "total", SUMX(CURRENTGROUP(), Product[ListPrice]), "n", COUNTX(CURRENTGROUP(), Product[ListPrice]))
EVALUATE DATATABLE("a", INTEGER, "b", STRING, "c", DOUBLE, "d", BOOLEAN, "e", DATETIME, "f", CURRENCY, {{1, "x", 1.5, TRUE, "2024-01-01", 2.5}, {2, "y", 2, FALSE, "2024-06-01 13:00", 3}})
